additional_info.subject: RE: ID0379649-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / P8 170000043] Defective C-fast card CRM:00645000770
additional_info.body:
Hi Simen,
As per the analysis, firmware within the CFast card seems corrupted. Please flash the card with the firmware and restore the config file of the charger.
Could you please let us know when are you planning to visit the site to perform this activity. We will plan it accordingly.
Additionally, please carry one spare Cfast card with you in case a replacement is needed.
Thank you
Best Regards,

I've checked the settings for both routers and only needed to remove the WAN Failover from Router 1.
Everything else looks fine as both connections are online.
If you agree I will close the ticket. I will wait for your feedback before closing.
Best regards,
Francisco
